name: gsd-status-mod
description: A Claude Code mod for GSD projects: a live pane (roadmap, agent tree with forks, cost and context, work streams, session log) plus a status band, a next-action hint and /gsd-status, read from .planning/.

openOnStart.title: Open the pane on start
openOnStart.description: Open the live GSD pane when a session starts in a GSD project. /gsd-board opens it later either way.
